stories.summary: Implement Native Video Compression for Production Builds

details.user_story: As a Developer, I want to implement real video compression in native builds (post-Expo Go) so that users benefit from reduced upload sizes and faster processing times.
details.context:
DM-29 added video compression infrastructure, but the actual compression is disabled in Expo Go due to native module limitations. When we build with EAS (DM-18), we need to implement real compression using FFmpeg or native compression libraries.

Current State:
- VideoCompressionService exists with proper API
- UI for compression progress is implemented
- Service currently skips compression and returns original file
- Works in Expo Go for development

Target State:
- Compress videos to 720p @ 2.5 Mbps before upload
- Reduce file sizes from 50-100MB to 10-20MB
- Prevent AI service crashes (512MB RAM limit)
- Improve upload speed and data usage
acceptance_criteria: Replace stub compression in VideoCompressionService with real FFmpeg or native compression
Compress videos to 720p (1280px width) with 2.5 Mbps bitrate
Handle compression failures gracefully (fallback to original)
Test on iOS and Android physical devices
Verify AI service processes compressed videos without crashes
technical_details: - Keep error handling and fallback logic
- Test compression quality vs file size trade-offs
edge_cases: Very short videos (< 1 second) - ensure compressor handles gracefully
Low device storage - check available space before compression
Compression failure - fallback to original file
App backgrounding during compression - resume when app returns
Very large files (> 100MB) - may need chunked processing or size limit
Different aspect ratios - maintain aspect ratio during compression
Portrait vs landscape videos - handle both orientations
